name: respire
description: respire memory for Dim: every-round title-tier recall, one-prefix store, degradation without models. Works fully offline; only encrypted records reach the cloud; enterprises can self-host the sync server. On-machine registration via rsrs register; the sidecar model is an optional boost.
author: risense-ai

interface.shortDescription: Store on inhale, recall on exhale — local encrypted memory for the Dim agent
interface.longDescription: respire (CLI: rsrs) gives the Dim agent a local-first, end-side-encrypted memory layer: every round injects title-tier recall automatically, a prompt starting with "Remember:" stores instantly, and the Stop hook nudges storing new facts and lessons. Local encrypted store; register on this machine with rsrs register for cloud sync (LWW). Works fully offline — no network or account needed to read and write; only encrypted records are uploaded, the server has no decryption key; enterprises can self-host the sync server (respire-server, Docker Compose + Postgres on the intranet). Optional BGE-M3 boost for semantic recall — falls back to lexical matching without it, works out of the box.
defaultPrompt: How did we handle this before?
Remember: store this conclusion in memory.
Recall the agreement we made last week.
